scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-env.js && concurrently -n "API,AI,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta,blue" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run seed && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: node scripts/sync-env.js && concurrently -n "API,AI,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta,blue" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:ai" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.seed: node scripts/sync-env.js && npm run seed:backend && npm run seed:ai
scripts.seed:backend: npm run seed --workspace=@flowdot/backend && npm run seed:demo --workspace=@flowdot/backend
